episodes.synopsis: Hiro is ready to play the coolest game around, Shadowverse. But when a bad guy steals his friend's phone, he'll have to endure a trial by fire if he wants to get it back!
episodes.title: This Is Shadowverse!!

episodes.synopsis: To get his friend's phone back, Hiro will have to challenge the toughest Shadowverse battler around: Luca Yonazuki.
episodes.title: Hiro's Resolve

episodes.synopsis: Hiro is challenged by an amazing new foe, the "genius among geniuses!" Can he stand against this intellectual onslaught?
episodes.title: The Plot of the Genius Among Geniuses

episodes.synopsis: Mimori wants to be someone special... like her favorite idol, Alice Kurobane. She meets a girl who offers to introduce her to Alice... if she can beat her in Shadowverse first!
episodes.title: Something Special

episodes.synopsis: Kazuki and Hiro face off at a local tournament, with an exciting prize on the line!
episodes.title: Fierce Battle! Hiro vs. Kazuki!

episodes.synopsis: Kai is interested in the secret of Luca Yonazuki's strength. But Luca only cares about one thing...
episodes.title: The Reason for Strength

episodes.synopsis: The National tournament is here, but if Hiro wants to enter, he'll need to get to Master Rank, and he'll need to do it in a single day!
episodes.title: Aim for Master Rank!

episodes.synopsis: The final rounds of the National Tournament have begun, and to make his way up the ranks, Hiro will first need to defeat the mysterious Elica!
episodes.title: The National Tournament Finals Begin!

episodes.synopsis: Hiro moves on to the second battle. His next opponent is Seiya, a powerful pro player!
episodes.title: The Curtain Rises! A Beautiful Witch Show!

episodes.synopsis: Hiro challenges the mysterious Maura to progress in the finals! Maura has plenty of tricks up his sleeve!
episodes.title: Mauro's Spellcasting!

episodes.synopsis: It's time to face off against Luca for the national championship! But he's no easy foe!
episodes.title: Hiro vs Luca

episodes.synopsis: The battle against Luca draws to a close! What drives him, and why does he play Shadowverse when he hates it?
episodes.title: Who Will Claim Victory?

episodes.synopsis: The nationals were just the beginning, it's time to challenge the whole world! The Shadow Gran Prix begins!
episodes.title: The Shadow Grand Prix Begins

episodes.synopsis: It's a mouth-watering battle as Hiro challenges a famous chef for his first match in the Shadow Gran Prix!
episodes.title: A Mouthwatering Battle! Marcel Tabeoka!

episodes.synopsis:
Hiro fights the incredibly rich, and incredibly bratty, Miyabi Zaizenji!

Is money enough to win at Shadowverse?
episodes.title: Super Rich! Miyabi Zaizenji!

episodes.synopsis: Alice and Minori team up for their first tag battle! But their opponents won't go easy on them!
episodes.title: An Invitation to the Underworld! The Joubert Sisters!

episodes.synopsis: Mimori and Alice face off! Is it better to be special, or normal?
episodes.title: Special and Ordinary

episodes.synopsis: Kai and Kazuki battle the crazy hunters Zuo and Ko in a battle of wits and courage against tag battle mastery!
episodes.title: A Terrible Trap! Zuo and Ko

episodes.synopsis: A new force has joined the Gran Prix, the mysterious Shadow Knights! These bearers of shadow will stop at nothing to take out the competitors!
episodes.title: Bearers of Shadow

episodes.synopsis: Mauro challenges Hiro to a rematch. If he wins, Hiro will learn the truth about the Shadow Gran Prix.
episodes.title: A Smile That's Black

episodes.synopsis: Hiro heads for the central tower to unlock the mysteries of the Gran Prix. Barring his way is Luca, who's ready for another confrontation.
episodes.title: Battle of Destiny

episodes.synopsis: Hiro and Luca finish their battle. Can Hiro open a path to Luca's heart?
episodes.title: Conclusion, and...

episodes.synopsis: The true nature of Shadowverse is revealed, as Hiro and his friends begin their ultimate test.
episodes.title: Unknown Encounter

episodes.synopsis: Hiro is forced to battle the 8th class, Portalcraft!
episodes.title: Blessings and Woe

episodes.synopsis: Having proved themselves worthy to battle the Tree of Woe, the team heads out into a shattered world to find the 7 legendary cards.
episodes.title: Seven Hopes

episodes.synopsis: Hiro fights a deadly duel against a pro player... to win the first legendary card!
episodes.title: Grab the Legend

episodes.synopsis: If he wants to beat Shiro, Hiro's going to need some help. He'll need the first legendary card: the awesome Infiniflame Dragon!
episodes.title: The Ultimate Dragon

episodes.synopsis: Kai and Alice battle the bounty hunter sisters for the rights to their own legendary cards.
episodes.title: Overlapping Answers!

episodes.synopsis: Luca tracks down his opponent: his own sister. If he wants to get the legendary card, he'll have to see the truth behind her fake smile...
episodes.title: Proof That I Am Me

episodes.synopsis: Mimori is locked in a tough battle with a possessed Seiya. She can't win on her own, but a familiar face has a score to settle with the pro player...
episodes.title: Resolve and Courage

episodes.synopsis: Kazuki is on the verge of losing to the duo of Zuo and Ko. But he'll never give up, no matter how bad it gets!
episodes.title: Hero's Blade

episodes.synopsis: Mauro suddenly challenges Luca to a battle without warning. What secrets is he hiding in his heart?
episodes.title: Footsteps of Hope

episodes.synopsis: Mauro is possessed by a huge number of Empty Shadows. They twist his mind, causing him to became an enemy of mankind. Hiro and Luca fight to bring him back.
episodes.title: Fate of Destruction

episodes.synopsis: Mauro's 3 divine instruments are too much for Hiro and Luca, and they're losing the battle. But still, Mauro is a friend, and a comrade. They'll bring him back no matter what it takes!
episodes.title: Battle of Despair

episodes.synopsis: Hiro finds himself meeting an unexpected person: his missing father. Now his father is on the side of the enemy!
episodes.title: Prelude to the End

episodes.synopsis: Hiro's battle with his father reaches its climatic end, with the fate of the world in the balance.
episodes.title: A Heart That Believes

episodes.synopsis: Hiro battles Rowen in this new, strange world. But Rowen's deck is a dragonslayer deck, which can insta-kill any dragon. How can Hiro's dragons defeat it?
episodes.title: A Voice That Calls to Awaken

episodes.synopsis: Hiiro battles the black dragon knight! But the knight's deck is full of dragonslayer cards, and Hiro's deck is a dragon deck!
episodes.title: Hiro and the Black Dragon Knight

episodes.synopsis: Mimori's the hottest idol around! But what good is it to be an idol in a world that's fake?
episodes.title: Mimori's an Idol

episodes.synopsis: Alice is happy in her new life, as an anonymous girl with no responsibilities. But it's time to go back to reality...
episodes.title: Alice's Truth

episodes.synopsis: Kazuki wakes up in a strange world, and quickly finds himself in a prison cell. How did he get here, and more importantly, how does he get out?
episodes.title: Kazuki's Great Escape!

episodes.synopsis: Kai is living a perfect life: getting a hundred percent on every test, mastering kendo, and never losing a game of Shadowverse. But what good is a world with no challenge for a genius among geniuses?
episodes.title: Kai and the Forbidden Magic

episodes.synopsis: Mauro's finally got what he's always wanted: a life where he's cared for and loved by Leon. Even if it's not real, can he bear to leave it behind?
episodes.title: Mauro's Wish, a Longing that Cannot Be

episodes.synopsis: Luca lives in a dream world, where Shiori is healthy and happy and spends her days playing Shadowverse. But what will he do when it's time to wake up?
episodes.title: Luca and the Undead King

episodes.synopsis: The seven chosen ones have awakened, and the hour of destiny is here. The final battle is about to begin.
episodes.title: Castle in the Sky

episodes.synopsis: Hiro falls to his knees before Eiji's overwhelming power. But Shadowverse is about never giving up.
episodes.title: Ruler of the World

episodes.synopsis: Leon uses his ultimate card, "Shadow Mode". Can Hiro control his rage long enough to stop the ultimate evil?
episodes.title: Time of Evolution

episodes.synopsis: Hiro has one final card to play to stop Leon from trapping the world in eternal slumber: the Ultimate Legendary Dragon, with the combined powers of all the legendary cards!
episodes.title: Battle! Shadowverse!
